units.name: Spear Bearers
units.description: Spear Bearers have a bow and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Stubborn. They may exchange bow for spear (-2), but the two variants may not be mixed. They may only be fielded in the presence of the Great King. They may have light amrour (+2). Spear armed troops may upgrade shield to large shield (+2).

units.description: Immortals are armed with bow, Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. May have light armour (+2).

units.name: Combined Formation Immortals
units.description: Immortals are armed with bow, Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. May have light armour (+2). Replace bow with spear and Spara (+4). Spara carriers may form the front rank or ranks of an otherwise bow armed unit. Combined Formation.

units.name: Line Infantry
units.description: Line Infantry have a bow. May have a shield (+2). May exchange bow for Spear and Spara (+4).

units.name: Combined Formation Line Infantry
units.description: Line Infantry have a bow. May have a shield (+2). May exchange bow for Spear and Spara (+4). Spara carriers form the front ranks of an otherwise bow armed unit. Combined Fomration.

units.description: Levy have spear. Inferior Fighters. Inferior Shooters. Levies. May have shield (+2), or large shield (+4). One unit with large shields may replace spear with throwing spear (+2). May have light armour (+2). May exchange spear for bow (+2).

units.name: Combined Formation Levy
units.description: Levy have spear. Inferior Fighters. Inferior Shooters. Levies. May have shield (+2), or large shield (+4). May have light armour (+2). Combined Formation. Bow armed troops form Combined Formation with Spearmen.

units.name: Light Levy
